title: Audit installed Codex resume session behavior
objective: Establish source-grounded and controlled empirical behavior for Codex CLI 0.151.0 session resume, multi-client message propagation, thread ownership, serialization, frontend lifetime, draft preservation, failure modes, exact session discovery, and public automation prior art before any authoritative wake transport is changed.
scope: installed codex-cli 0.151.0 help, package, binary behavior, process topology, app-server behavior, rollout/session storage, and exact rust-v0.151.0 openai/codex source
official CLI reference as secondary evidence plus GitHub source, issues, discussions, web search, and public repository prior art for codex resume SESSION_ID MESSAGE or equivalent
deterministic mapping of the persistent tmux TUI process and rollout metadata to session 01a05952-e1fa-71e2-adea-df7e3f7d99ce, with stale-binding detection requirements
preservation and analysis of the operator-observed Desktop experiment in session 01a05a17-c5c5-7463-8670-14c5127f2072 where injected test produced Received while the original frontend continued

controlled disposable interactive-session experiments for empty composer, synthetic simple draft, synthetic multiline draft, active reasoning, concurrent submission, duplicate prompt, two near-simultaneous resumes, and temporary frontend disposal
a precise implementation contract for provider-free wake dispatch, activation lease, generation fencing, idempotency, queued recovery, pause-after-evaluation, and tiny durable-event messages

may: inspect this repository, installed Codex artifacts, process metadata, tmux metadata, and local Codex rollout/session files read-only
query official OpenAI documentation, exact-tag openai/codex GitHub source, GitHub issues/discussions/code, web search, and public repositories
create and dispose bounded temporary Codex test frontends/sessions that are explicitly not repository supervisors and cannot modify this repository
use synthetic test composer drafts in disposable sessions and preserve exact before/after screen and rollout hashes
record source URLs, commit/tag hashes, commands, process identities, timestamps, rollout offsets, and experiment receipts in completion evidence
may_not: invoke codex resume against the persistent authoritative tmux TUI session 01a05952-e1fa-71e2-adea-df7e3f7d99ce
invoke codex resume against the current corrective activation or the operator experiment session
type into, clear, submit, overwrite, or otherwise mutate any real human composer draft
change .opsle authority, source, tests, documentation, policy, objective, claims, tasks, events, wake requests, dispatcher state, tmux, or Herdr beyond Runner-owned attempt evidence
create a second repository supervisor, initialize another repository, install or upgrade Codex, enable Claude or review, modify sibling repositories, deploy, merge, push, or install server-wide
treat official documentation silence as disproof of observed installed behavior or invoke Graphify without a Gearbox selection

relevant_context: The authoritative durable identity is supervisor-1005d601-4da1-4f6b-a7fa-f0b71dedabbe generation 12 and remains PAUSED with no active work or active claims after exact reconciliation.

The persistent tmux TUI process started 2026-08-31 19:36:37 UTC and session_meta binds it to Codex TUI session 01a05952-e1fa-71e2-adea-df7e3f7d99ce, cwd exactly this repository, cli_version 0.151.0, originator codex-tui.
The current corrective activation is a separate Codex Desktop frontend/session and does not create a second .opsle supervisor identity.

The operator demonstrated codex resume 01a05a17-c5c5-7463-8670-14c5127f2072 test; the target rollout durably records user test at 12:23:40 UTC and assistant Received at 12:23:46 UTC while the original frontend continued.

Official OpenAI CLI reference calls codex resume stable and supports an explicit UUID and optional prompt, but does not state multi-client injection, composer, serialization, or frontend-lifetime guarantees.

Four historical wake requests are immutable and receipt-free; three target stale generation 9, one targets generation 12 but its task has already been accepted without keystroke delivery. Do not rewrite or deliver them during audit.
Herdr remains a viable host/sidebar layer but its agent.prompt is PTY transport without draft-safety guarantees; wake transport is now independent of host selection.
expected_deliverable: A complete_for_decision evidence packet containing exact installed/source findings, public prior art, controlled experiment receipts, deterministic session-binding and stale-detection rules, a concurrency/failure matrix, and the smallest safe implementation contract or an exact fail-closed limitation.
expected_evidence: codex-cli 0.151.0 command/help, package provenance, exact rust-v0.151.0 tag commit, and exact source paths governing resume, prompt submission, thread loading, input queuing, and multi-client notifications
local process/session/rollout evidence separating durable supervisor identity, persistent TUI session, operator experiment session, and temporary corrective frontend
source-backed explanation of whether resume attaches to an existing logical thread, creates a second core, queues a turn, serializes against active turns, and propagates events to other clients
controlled disposable-TUI before/after evidence for empty, simple draft, multiline draft, active reasoning, near-simultaneous human input, two terminal events, duplicates, and frontend disposal
GitHub issues/discussions and at least two public automation/code-search findings where available, with absence stated honestly if no relevant prior art exists
failure behavior for invalid/missing/stale/deleted session, cwd mismatch, busy thread, concurrent resume, frontend termination, and rollout/file locking
deterministic authoritative session discovery and validation algorithm bound to repository, supervisor ID, generation, host process identity, rollout session_meta, and stale process/rollout facts

implementation recommendations for activation lease, event idempotency, tiny message format, recovery, queued obsolete events, pause-after-evaluation, Herdr hosting, tmux fallback, and wait-cell fallback
zero repository source changes and zero authoritative-session prompts
acceptance_criteria: uses actual installed Codex 0.151.0 behavior and exact-tag source rather than documentation assumptions
preserves the operator experiment as positive empirical evidence without overgeneralizing it
does not touch the authoritative persistent TUI or any human draft
controlled experiments are disposable, bounded, and independently evidenced
all concurrency and recovery cases are classified as proven, unproven, or unsafe with exact evidence
Context Firewall packet is complete_for_decision with no unexpected changed artifacts
prohibited_actions: authoritative-session wake delivery before implementation fencing
terminal keystroke delivery to any real human composer
source changes, merge, deployment, installation, policy change, host migration, or history rewrite
model polling or Graphify without Gearbox selection
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
